title: Ron Simmons breaks through against Vader
summary: A replacement opportunity puts Ron Simmons opposite the seemingly overwhelming champion. His upset becomes a landmark WCW title victory, followed by Vader’s pursuit of revenge.

chapters.title: Simmons becomes WCW’s first Black world champion
chapters.result: Simmons defeats Vader for the WCW World championship.
chapters.context: A drawing gives Simmons the opportunity, and his victory becomes one of the company’s defining celebrations. This uses the event date, before the televised airing.

chapters.title: Vader ends Simmons’ reign
chapters.result: Vader defeats Simmons to regain the championship.
chapters.context: The rematch restores Vader’s position after Simmons’ historic run with the title.
